_about: Settings verified by hand to have no effect in this plugin version (find_inert.py lists candidates; each was checked in the code). The reference pages mark them, so nobody tunes a setting that does nothing. Key: Owner.MemberName.
UPerceptionProfile.HearingBaseThreshold: No code reads it: there is no noise floor. Use Suspect Threshold, and a Sound Filter Profile's Min Alert Level.
UPerceptionProfile.bSoundEventOnlyMode: No code reads it: hearing is always event-only (it hears only the sounds you emit).
UPerceptionProfile.TouchConfidence: No code reads it: touch strength comes from the contact report and the contact type's multiplier.
UPerceptionProfile.ConfidenceDecaySmooth: No code reads it. Use Confidence Rise Rate, and each sense's Confidence Decay Multiplier in the Loss settings.
UPerceptionProfile.ConfidenceReduceDelay: No code reads it. Use Confidence Rise Rate, and each sense's Confidence Decay Multiplier in the Loss settings.
USoundTypeDefinition.bIsDirectional: No code reads it: how precisely a sound is placed comes from Location Accuracy Override (or the distance-based default).
USoundTypeDefinition.Priority: No code reads it: when more than Max Pending per Tick sounds of one type arrive in a tick, the quietest is replaced by a louder one.
USenseUnit_Touch.MaxPersistentBonus: Not used: the profile's Touch Max Persistent Bonus always sets the cap.
USenseUnit_Touch.MaxImpulseForFullStreng: Overwritten every tick by the profile's Touch Max Impulse for Full Strength, unless that is 0.
USenseUnit_Touch.PersistentAccumulationR: Overwritten every tick by the profile's Touch Persistent Accumulation Rate, unless that is 0.
UPerceptionCore.CurrentState: Not updated by APS 3.0: always UNAWARE.
FPlayerBehaviorModel.CustomBehaviorRatio: Stays empty in APS 3.0: no node or APS code records into it.
FBeliefRecord.DamageDealtToTarget: Never written by APS 3.0: always 0 (only Debug Reset Damage Tracking touches it, to set it to 0). Track damage the AI deals in your own code.
